summary: Four relaxed days from DC to Asheville in an RV, mixing farm stays with one hotel night in Roanoke.

stops.reason: A hillside vineyard right off the route.
An easy leg-stretch at Luray Caverns.

overnight.reason: The farm sits just past Staunton, a comfortable first day.

days.narrative: Leave DC early and climb into the Blue Ridge foothills. Taste wine at Linden and wander the car museum at Luray. Park the RV at Dices Spring Farm.

stops.reason: A valley winery a few minutes from last night's farm.
Outdoor farm exhibits just down the road.

overnight.reason: A well-priced hotel night in Roanoke before the long Parkway day.

days.narrative: Start with a tasting at Barren Ridge, then the Frontier Culture Museum near Staunton. Roll south to Roanoke and sleep in a real bed tonight.

overnight.reason: Shipley Farms near Boone breaks the longest leg of the trip.

days.narrative: Today is the longest drive, into the North Carolina high country. Take it slow and reach Shipley Farms by late afternoon.

stops.reason: Living history in Boone on the way out.

days.narrative: Visit the Hickory Ridge History Museum before heading south. Drive the last stretch and end at the Asheville Art Museum downtown.
